title: AI Assistant — Agentic Coding Cheat Sheet
brandSub: AI Chat · Code Completion · In-Editor Actions · Agents · MCP · BYOK

rows.label: Plugin install
rows.value: Settings | Plugins | Marketplace → search AI Assistant → Install (not bundled by default)

rows.label: IDEs supported
rows.value: IntelliJ IDEA, PyCharm, GoLand, WebStorm, Rider, CLion, PhpStorm, RubyMine, RustRover, DataGrip, DataSpell + Android Studio & ReSharper

rows.label: Min IDE version
rows.value: 2023.3+ required; Community Edition needs 2024.1.1+; PyCharm Unified needs 2025.1+

rows.label: Activation
rows.value: Open AI Chat → choose: JetBrains AI subscription, BYOK API key, provider OAuth, or ACP agent

rows.label: Free trial
rows.value: 30-day AI Pro trial — click Start Free Trial in AI Chat; payment card required to verify

rows.label: AI Free tier
rows.value: 3 AI Credits / 30 days; no top-up; not available in Community Editions or Android Studio

rows.label: Disable for project
rows.value: Click JetBrains AI widget → Disable for This Project; or create .noai in project root

rows.label: Data not stored
rows.value: Prompts routed through JetBrains AI service but not stored unless Send detailed code-related data is enabled

rows.label: JetBrains Pick
rows.value: AI Chat opens with a recommended agent by default — chosen via DPAIA benchmark (solve rate, cost, latency, A/B tests)

rows.label: Cloud agents
rows.value: Run agents in isolated cloud via JetBrains Air; agent works on a remote branch while you continue locally (JetBrains Central orgs only)

rows.label: Agent skills
rows.value: Reusable structured abilities for Claude Agent & Codex; install from public registries or create custom; invoke with $skill-name

rows.label: ACP support
rows.value: Agent Client Protocol — connect any ACP-compatible external agent; configure in ~/.jetbrains/acp.json

rows.label: Next edit suggestions
rows.value: AI predicts your next edit; press Tab to jump to suggestion, Tab again to apply (not on AI Free tier)

rows.label: Java → Kotlin AI
rows.value: AI-assisted Java-to-Kotlin conversion in IntelliJ IDEA Ultimate: Code | Convert Java to Kotlin | AI-Assisted

rows.label: Perforce MCP
rows.value: Configure Perforce MCP server at Settings | Version Control | Perforce | Perforce MCP for P4 context in AI

rows.label: Exp. features plugin
rows.value: AI Assistant Experimental Features plugin adds Recap, Insights, and Group with AI (requires detailed data collection on)

rows.label: Open AI Chat
rows.value: Click AI Chat button on right toolbar; in DataGrip: More tool windows → AI Assistant

rows.label: Switch mode
rows.value: Click the chat mode selector (top-left) to switch between Chat, Junie, Claude Agent, Codex, GitHub Copilot, or ACP agents

rows.label: New chat
rows.value: Click New Chat button or press Alt+Insert

rows.label: Send / new line
rows.value: Enter sends; Shift+Enter inserts a newline without sending

rows.label: Send to new chat
rows.value: Press Ctrl+Shift+Enter to open a new chat and send there

rows.label: Send Now
rows.value: Ctrl+Enter interrupts current generation and sends your prompt immediately

rows.label: Search in chat
rows.value: Press Ctrl+F inside a chat to search message history

rows.label: Chat in editor tab
rows.value: Click Show Chats in Editor Tabs to open conversation as an editor tab for more space

rows.label: @mentions
rows.value: Type @ in chat: @thisFile, @selection, @problems, @localChanges, @projectStructure, @commit:, @symbol:

rows.label: File / folder ref
rows.value: @file:filename or @folder:foldername; also drag & drop files directly into chat

rows.label: Add attachment
rows.value: Click the Add attachment button (clip icon) → Files & Folders, Add Image, Add context from UI, or Database Schema

rows.label: Image context
rows.value: Attach screenshots (max 20 MB) — AI reads code, error messages, or UI mockups from images

rows.label: Codebase mode
rows.value: Enabled by default; AI gathers project context automatically. Disable via Options → Enable Codebase Mode

rows.label: Database object
rows.value: Type @dbObject: to attach a schema or table — improves SQL generation quality

rows.label: Trimming threshold
rows.value: Set at Settings | AI Assistant → Trim message if it exceeds % of model context window

rows.label: Review attachments
rows.value: Click any attachment chip in chat to preview it; click the context button on a sent message to see what was sent

rows.label: Auto-trigger
rows.value: Suggestions appear while typing in editor, AI Chat input, commit message, and code comments

rows.label: Manual trigger
rows.value: Press Alt+Shift+\ to invoke cloud completion manually

rows.label: Accept all
rows.value: Press Tab (configurable) to accept the entire suggestion

rows.label: Accept word
rows.value: Press Ctrl+→ to accept one word at a time

rows.label: Accept line
rows.value: Press End to accept one line at a time

rows.label: Reject
rows.value: Press Esc or continue typing to dismiss the suggestion

rows.label: Completion policy
rows.value: Settings | Editor | General | Code Completion | Inline → Creative / Balanced / Focused

rows.label: Default model
rows.value: Cloud completion uses Mellum by default (JetBrains LLM optimized for completion); configurable to OpenAI-compatible endpoint

rows.label: Generate code
rows.value: Press Ctrl+\ on empty line → type prompt; or Right-click → AI Actions → Generate Code

rows.label: Edit selection
rows.value: Select code → press Ctrl+\ → type modification prompt; click Accept All or Discard All

rows.label: Explain code
rows.value: Select code → Right-click → AI Actions → Explain Code; also explains RegExp, SQL, cron fragments

rows.label: Generate tests
rows.value: Right-click → AI Actions → Generate Unit Tests; opens AI Diff tab; click Specify to refine

rows.label: Write docs
rows.value: Right-click → AI Actions → Write Documentation; or type /** (IDEA/PhpStorm), """ (PyCharm), // (GoLand) then Enter

rows.label: Find problems
rows.value: Select code → click sparkle icon in popup → Find Problems

rows.label: Suggest refactoring
rows.value: Select code → click sparkle icon → Suggest Refactoring; apply via diff view

rows.label: AI Actions menu
rows.value: Press Alt+Enter anywhere in editor to open context-sensitive AI Actions menu

rows.label: Ctrl+\
rows.value: In editor: generate code (empty line) or edit selected code with a prompt

rows.label: Alt+Enter
rows.value: Open AI Actions context menu in the editor

rows.label: Alt+Shift+\
rows.value: Manually invoke cloud code completion

rows.label: Alt+Insert
rows.value: Open a new AI Chat conversation

rows.label: Ctrl+Shift+'
rows.value: Maximize / restore the AI Chat tool window

rows.label: Ctrl+F
rows.value: Search through current chat (when focus is in chat); search chat history (when in history list)

rows.label: Customize shortcuts
rows.value: Settings | Keymap | Plugins | JetBrains AI Assistant

rows.label: Assign chat shortcut
rows.value: Settings | Keymap | Tool Windows | AI Assistant to bind a key to open AI Chat

rows.label: Select model
rows.value: Click model name button in AI Chat → choose from JetBrains AI, BYOK, or local model list

rows.label: Auto model
rows.value: Set model to Auto — AI Assistant picks the best balance of performance and cost

rows.label: BYOK setup
rows.value: Settings | Tools | AI Assistant | Providers & API keys → select Provider → enter API Key → Test Connection

rows.label: Supported providers
rows.value: Anthropic, OpenAI, Google (Gemini API or Vertex AI with ADC), OpenAI-compatible endpoints, Ollama, LM Studio

rows.label: Local models
rows.value: Connect Ollama or LM Studio at Settings | Tools | AI Assistant | Providers & API keys; default context 64k tokens

rows.label: Model hints
rows.value: Brain icon = reasoning model; Ruby icon = high-cost model; Beta icon = less predictable behavior

rows.label: Assign to features
rows.value: In Model Assignment section: set Core features model and Instant helpers model separately (local/OpenAI-compat only)

rows.label: AI Completion provider
rows.value: Override completion model at Providers & API keys → AI Completion (needs FIM or edit-prediction support)

rows.label: Junie
rows.value: JetBrains agent; JetBrains AI subscription only; reads AGENTS.md; respects .aiignore

rows.label: Claude Agent
rows.value: Anthropic agent; auth: JetBrains AI, API key, or Anthropic Console; reads CLAUDE.md

rows.label: Codex
rows.value: OpenAI agent; auth: JetBrains AI, OpenAI API key, or ChatGPT account; reads AGENTS.md

rows.label: GitHub Copilot
rows.value: GitHub OAuth only; no JetBrains AI or BYOK; reads AGENTS.md & CLAUDE.md; no Remote Dev

rows.label: Approve actions
rows.value: Agents ask permission before running commands or editing files; click Allow once, Always allow, or Deny

rows.label: Brave / auto mode
rows.value: Enable Brave mode (Junie) or select Don't Ask / Bypass (Claude Agent) to auto-approve actions

rows.label: Rollback changes
rows.value: Hover file in changed-files pane → click revert icon to roll back one file; click Rollback for all files

rows.label: Reasoning level
rows.value: All agents support selectable reasoning level — higher = better quality on complex tasks, but slower

rows.label: Add MCP server
rows.value: Settings | Tools | AI Assistant | Model Context Protocol (MCP) → click Add → paste JSON config

rows.label: STDIO config format
rows.value: {"mcpServers":{"name":{"command":"...","args":["..."]}}}

rows.label: HTTP config format
rows.value: {"mcpServers":{"name":{"url":"https://example.com/mcp"}}}

rows.label: Import from Claude
rows.value: Click Import from Claude on MCP settings page to reuse your Claude Desktop MCP configuration

rows.label: Invoke MCP tools
rows.value: Type / in chat to list available MCP commands; agents also invoke them automatically when relevant

rows.label: IDE as MCP server
rows.value: Enable bundled MCP Server plugin: Settings | Tools | MCP Server → Enable MCP Server

rows.label: Auto-configure client
rows.value: In MCP Server settings, click Auto-Configure next to Junie, VS Code, Claude Code, Codex, etc.

rows.label: Brave mode for MCP
rows.value: Settings | Tools | MCP Server → Run shell commands without confirmation to skip per-action approval

rows.label: Generate commit msg
rows.value: In Commit tool window (Alt+0), click the Generate Commit Message icon

rows.label: Custom commit prompt
rows.value: Settings | Tools | AI Assistant | Prompt Library → Commit Message Generation; use $GIT_BRANCH_NAME variable

rows.label: Self-Review
rows.value: In Commit tool window, click Self-Review with AI to detect issues before committing

rows.label: Review guidelines
rows.value: Point Settings | AI Assistant | Project Settings → Path to rules for AI Self-Review to a Markdown file

rows.label: Explain commit
rows.value: In Git log, right-click commit → Explain Commit with AI Assistant

rows.label: PR title & desc
rows.value: In PR/MR creation dialog, click the AI icon in the description field to generate title and description

rows.label: Merge with AI
rows.value: In Merge Revisions dialog, click Merge with AI to auto-resolve Git conflicts

rows.label: Auto shelf title
rows.value: Silently shelving (Ctrl+Shift+H) auto-generates a title; disable at Settings | AI Assistant → Generate shelf title

rows.label: Prompt Library
rows.value: Settings | Tools | AI Assistant | Prompt Library — add custom prompts or modify built-in action prompts

rows.label: Create prompt
rows.value: Right-click in editor → AI Actions → Add Your Prompts; use $SELECTION variable for selected code

rows.label: Save chat prompt
rows.value: Hover over a chat message → click menu → Save Current Prompt to add it to the Prompt Library

rows.label: Chat instructions
rows.value: Edit General → Chat Instructions prompt in Prompt Library to inject instructions into every new chat

rows.label: Project rules
rows.value: Settings | Tools | AI Assistant | Rules → create .aiassistant/rules/*.md; types: Always, Manually, By model decision, By file patterns

rows.label: Invoke rule manually
rows.value: Use @rule:rulename or #rule:rulename in chat to apply a rule on demand

rows.label: Agent instructions
rows.value: Create AGENTS.md (or CLAUDE.md for Claude Agent) in project root — agents read it automatically

rows.label: /commands
rows.value: Built-in: /docs, /explain, /refactor, /web, /help; extended by MCP servers and coding agents

rows.label: .aiignore file
rows.value: Create at project root (gitignore syntax); enable at Settings | AI Assistant | Project Settings; Junie respects it; Claude Agent & Codex do not

rows.label: Disable for project
rows.value: JetBrains AI widget → Disable for This Project, or add empty .noai to project root

rows.label: Disable permanently
rows.value: Widget → Disable Permanently via Plugin to disable the plugin entirely

rows.label: View requests log
rows.value: Search Everywhere → Open AI Assistant Requests Log in Editor → review ai-assistant-requests.md

rows.label: Detailed data opt-in
rows.value: Settings | Appearance & Behavior | System Settings | Data Sharing → Send detailed code-related data (off by default)

rows.label: Block at network
rows.value: Block https://api.jetbrains.ai/ and https://api.app.prod.grazie.aws.intellij.net/ to restrict access at network level

rows.label: BYOK data flow
rows.value: With BYOK, prompts go directly to your provider — JetBrains never sees them

rows.label: Enterprise controls
rows.value: JetBrains IDE Services / JetBrains Central admins can restrict providers, MCP servers, and agents org-wide

rows.label: Track quota
rows.value: JetBrains AI widget (toolbar) shows monthly credits left and top-up balance with a progress bar

rows.label: Quota reset
rows.value: Resets every 30 days from your first use date; AI Pro = 10 credits/30 days individual, 20 credits org

rows.label: Top-up credits
rows.value: Purchase extra AI Credits from the widget or JetBrains Account; valid 12 months; consumed after monthly quota

rows.label: High usage causes
rows.value: Long chat threads (context grows), high-cost models (ruby icon), heavy agent-mode use

rows.label: Reduce usage
rows.value: Start a new chat per topic; switch to cheaper models; upgrade to AI Ultimate (35 credits/30 days individual)

rows.label: Multiple licenses
rows.value: AI Chat → Options → Manage License to switch between active licenses

rows.label: Log out of JB AI
rows.value: Settings | Tools | AI Assistant | Providers & API keys → JetBrains AI → Log out

rows.label: ACP no subscription
rows.value: ACP-compatible agents can be used without a JetBrains AI subscription (provider billing applies)

rows.label: Attach precise context
rows.value: Use @file:, @symbol:, or drag files into chat instead of describing code from memory

rows.label: Plan before executing
rows.value: Ask agent to propose a plan first (or use Plan mode), then review before letting it change files

rows.label: One task per chat
rows.value: Start a new chat (Alt+Insert) for each unrelated task — stale context degrades response quality

rows.label: Chain next-edit
rows.value: Enable Chain suggestions at Settings → Next Edit Suggestions to auto-request the next suggestion after accepting

rows.label: Verify agent work
rows.value: Tell the agent to run tests after changes: "run ./gradlew test and confirm build passes before finishing"

rows.label: IDE context toggle
rows.value: Click the IDE context indicator in agent chat input to toggle automatic file/selection attachment per prompt

rows.label: Context window monitor
rows.value: Watch the context usage indicator in Claude Agent / Codex chat; start a new session when it nears full

rows.label: Custom response lang
rows.value: Settings | AI Assistant → Receive AI Assistant chat responses in a custom language for non-English responses
